execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."AttendanceStatus" AS ENUM ('PRESENT', 'LATE', 'ABSENT', 'EXCUSED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ConflictSeverity" AS ENUM ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ConflictType" AS ENUM ('MULTIPLE_DEVICES', 'LOCATION_MISMATCH', 'IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL', 'UNUSUAL_PATTERN')
CREATE TYPE "public"."DevicePlatform" AS ENUM ('ANDROID', 'IOS', 'WEB', 'OTHER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."DeviceStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'REVOKED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."EnrollmentStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'DROPPED', 'COMPLETED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."EventType" AS ENUM ('JOINED', 'HEARTBEAT', 'LEFT', 'REJOINED', 'TIMEOUT', 'SESSION_ENDED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."Role" AS ENUM ('STUDENT', 'FACULTY', 'ADMIN')
CREATE TYPE "public"."RoomStatus" AS ENUM ('AVAILABLE', 'MAINTENANCE', 'OUT_OF_SERVICE')
CREATE TYPE "public"."SessionStatus" AS ENUM ('SCHEDULED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'ENDED', 'CANCELLED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')

CREATE TABLE "public"."Admin" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AttendanceConflict" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "detectedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resolution" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamp(3),
  "resolvedBy" text,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "severity" "ConflictSeverity" NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "type" "ConflictType" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AttendanceRecord" (
  "calculatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "presencePercentage" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "AttendanceStatus" NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "totalAbsentSeconds" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalPresentSeconds" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AttendanceSession" (
  "classId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endedAt" timestamp(3),
  "expectedEndAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "facultyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionPublicId" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamp(3),
  "status" "SessionStatus" DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED'::"SessionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text NOT NULL,
  "entityType" text NOT NULL,
  "eventHash" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "previousHash" text,
  "timestamp" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Class" (
  "classroomId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facultyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Classroom" (
  "building" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "floor" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "roomNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "RoomStatus" DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE'::"RoomStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Course" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Department" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Enrollment" (
  "classId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "EnrollmentStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"EnrollmentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Faculty" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "employeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PresenceEvent" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text,
  "eventType" "EventType" NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "timestamp" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Section" (
  "courseId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Student" (
  "courseId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."StudentDevice" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceName" text,
  "devicePublicKey" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamp(3),
  "platform" "DevicePlatform" DEFAULT 'OTHER'::"DevicePlatform" NOT NULL,
  "registeredAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" "DeviceStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"DeviceStatus" NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Subject" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credits" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" "Role" NOT NULL,
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Admin_userId_key" ON "public"."Admin" ("userId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AttendanceRecord_sessionId_studentId_key" ON "public"."AttendanceRecord" ("sessionId", "studentId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AttendanceSession_sessionPublicId_key" ON "public"."AttendanceSession" ("sessionPublicId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Classroom_building_roomNumber_key" ON "public"."Classroom" ("building", "roomNumber")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Course_code_key" ON "public"."Course" ("code")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Department_code_key" ON "public"."Department" ("code")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Enrollment_studentId_classId_key" ON "public"."Enrollment" ("studentId", "classId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Faculty_employeeId_key" ON "public"."Faculty" ("employeeId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Faculty_userId_key" ON "public"."Faculty" ("userId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Section_name_courseId_year_key" ON "public"."Section" ("name", "courseId", "year")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Student_studentId_key" ON "public"."Student" ("studentId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Student_userId_key" ON "public"."Student" ("userId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "StudentDevice_devicePublicKey_key" ON "public"."StudentDevice" ("devicePublicKey")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Subject_code_key" ON "public"."Subject" ("code")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "User_email_key" ON "public"."User" ("email")
